assumptions: Methods reimplementation from PDF; exact authors split and implementation unavailable.
83-feature planar adaptation: 18 firstorder + 9 shape2D + 24 GLCM + 16 GLRLM + 16 GLSZM; Appendix A lists 3D shapes instead.
ROI radiomics uses an ellipse inside the predicted thyroid box; exact radiomics mask not specified in paper.
Histogram equalization: per-image min-max to uint8 then cv2.equalizeHist. Radiomics image 512x512; detector input 256x256.
RSI is the direct uptake ratio on original cropped counts, before interpolation or equalization.
Radiomics: binWidth=25, unit pixel spacing, no filters, no resampling in PyRadiomics; not specified by paper.
HCL: absolute Pearson correlation, average linkage with distance 1-|rho|; components smaller than cutoff retain individual features.
Normalized cluster features are averaged without sign alignment; scaler and clusters fit separately inside each training fold.
Kernel SVC uses L2 regularization, gamma=scale, coef0=0; paper mentions L1/L2 without enough implementation detail.
Table4 configurations are fixed in advance; this run does not recreate unspecified exhaustive authors GridSearch.
Default split is deterministic stratified grouped 80/20, not the unavailable original paper split.
Default patient groups are conservative normalized CSV-name proxies, not verified clinical patient identifiers.
Detector pretraining overlap with these scans is unknown; this cannot establish independent clinical validation.
Missing ROI/features are abstentions, reported in coverage and by label; no ground-truth ROI fallback.
